content: Comparable products are demonstrably VULNERABLE to indirect injection: Perplexity Comet hijacked by invisible text in a Reddit post -> leaked OTP to attacker server (Brave disclosure 2025-08); Perplexity attempted 2 fixes, still not fully mitigated. Brave's stated mitigation = clearly separate user instructions from page content, treat page as untrusted-data. Core unsolved problem: to an LLM, trusted instructions + untrusted content are one token stream; nobody has a complete distinguisher. Honest local-first bar: defense-in-depth (strip active markup, provenance-fence as data-not-instructions, classifier flag) that REDUCES risk and surfaces detections, never claims immunity. Egress bounding is the real backstop vs exfiltration.
